title: Rigby's Confectionary, Main Street. (Later Goldie Millers)
description: Henry Bradley once owned the building on upper Main Street, running a shoe shop where he made and repaired footwear. In 1934, the Rigby family bought the property and operated a restaurant before selling it to Goldie Miller, who continued the restaurant and added a confectionery business. Pictured in the doorway is Mrs. Roy Rigby, mother of Carl Rigby.
